observations.body: The men travel from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, go through the Negev, and reach Hebron and the valley of Eshcol.
observations.label: The men survey the land and return with its fruit: action

observations.body: They cut a grape cluster carried on a pole with pomegranates and figs, then return after forty days.
observations.label: The men survey the land and return with its fruit: response

observations.body: spied out · Hebron · Eshcol · cluster · forty days

payload.posture: Read Numbers 13:21–25 as the mission and the divided report evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The fruit visibly supports the land’s abundance but does not by itself settle how Israel should respond to fortified cities and large inhabitants.
